summary: Tested IGSS medications with 'frecuencia de uso' (backend + UI). Login for igss.admin works (goes to /pacientes). Clicking 'Agregar' in the IGSS section shows the medication autocomplete plus the frequency input. Both fields can be edited and are kept separate (nombre/frecuencia). Saving with Guardar (POST and PUT) stores {nombre, frecuencia} correctly. Reopening the evaluation from Historial loads both fields. Old evaluations with string medications load as {nombre, frecuencia:''}, the frequency can be added, and saving converts them to objects. One real problem: autosave (PATCH /autoguardar) does not save igss_med_proc, so changes saved only by autosave are silently lost even though the UI says 'Guardado a las HH:MM'.

critical.issue: 'igss_med_proc' is missing from the allowed_fields whitelist (routes/evaluaciones.py ~line 1321). Edits to IGSS medications/frequency/procedures on an existing evaluation are dropped by autosave while the UI shows 'Guardado a las ...'. Reproduced in the API test and in the UI: edited frequency, autosave ran, DB still had the old value. They only persist if the user clicks Guardar.

minor.issue: It accepts a raw dict with no Pydantic validation. Once igss_med_proc is added to the whitelist, run it through MedicamentosProcedimientosIGSS so the data stays normalized (strings converted, empty names removed).

integration_issues.issue: This is the backend whitelist problem above as the user experiences it: the status says saved but the IGSS changes are not saved.

issues: The frequency input has only a placeholder and no label. Once filled, it looks the same as the medication name input above it. Consider a small 'Frecuencia' label/prefix or a different style.

action_items: Add 'igss_med_proc' to allowed_fields in PATCH /evaluaciones/{id}/autoguardar and validate/normalize it with MedicamentosProcedimientosIGSS (model_dump) before $set.
Optional: add a visible label to the frequency input.
critical_code_review_comments: The backend validator silently drops medications with an empty nombre even if a frecuencia was typed. That is acceptable, but the UI gives no hint.
The section is not gated by the patient's IGSS institution (it shows for all patients). The review request says it 'only appears for IGSS patients'; check whether that is intended.
EvaluacionOftalmologica.js is over 3000 lines. It should be split (CollapsibleSection, Autocomplete, IGSS section, print templates).
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/EvaluacionOftalmologica.js (added data-testid='eval-guardar-btn' to the Guardar button only)

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the requested flows (add, edit, Guardar, reopen, legacy); autosave persistence fails

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /evaluacion-oftalmologica?paciente_id=<id>, then historial-toggle-btn and historial-item-{id} to reopen. The IGSS section is collapsed by default; open it with get_by_role('button', name='Medicamentos y Procedimientos (EXCLUSIVO IGSS)'). After the fix, rerun test_autoguardar_persists_igss.
rca of the issue: The autoguardar endpoint filters the body by a hard-coded allowed_fields list that never included 'igss_med_proc' (or the newer fields). The frontend autosave sends the full formData, but the backend discards igss_med_proc and still returns 200, so the UI shows 'Guardado'. Fix: add 'igss_med_proc' to the list and normalize it through the Pydantic model.
